title: Liveness and Readiness Probes
description: The foundation: every service exposes cheap endpoints that answer 'am I alive' and 'can I serve', so detection starts from ground truth instead of guesses.
architecture: Probes run on fixed intervals with timeouts; consecutive failures cross a threshold before anything is declared.
acceptance_tests: The demo's probe marks the killed service down within the configured threshold.

title: Threshold-Based Alerting
description: Fires alerts when a metric crosses a declared boundary — error rate, latency, queue depth — with hysteresis so flapping does not page anyone twice.
architecture: Alert rules carry warn/critical thresholds and cool-downs; state changes are logged.
acceptance_tests: The demo alert fires once per real crossing and stays quiet during flapping.
